key_points: KO reported an earnings beat and raised its forward outlook.
Seeking Alpha reiterated a Sell rating citing steep valuation and insider selling.
Insider activity showed both buying (Canandaigua National Trust) and selling (Park National Corp, MRA Advisory).
Wells Fargo cut its price target to $90, reflecting valuation concerns.
Market debate continues over KO's relative value vs. PepsiCo ahead of earnings.
